items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: "I have to have somebody here to talk with Phil [Kornhiser] and a couple of the guys that the -- the publishers and get tunes from them"

ctx.x: He said, 'Can't you sublet them or something like that, something like that, he said. Anyway he says, 'Okay, if you don't

want to go it's all right." He said, "I have to have somebody here to talk with Phil [Kornhiser] and a couple of the guys that the -- the publishers and get tunes from them and you can do that, and we'll go out.

So they went out and then they made the picture so I had nothing to do with it. I wasn't in it. I wasn't around when it was done, and they were doing, now, they're doing the Old Gold Show, doing them all from the road, and at the same time business is getting worse and worse and we have had the Wall Street crash.
